normalized_callsign.description: Uppercase, trimmed, whitespace-free callsign used for uniqueness comparison.

display_callsign.description: Original callsign as entered by the primary account holder.

primary_user_id.description: User id of the primary callsign account holder. Exactly one per callsign.

primary_user_name.description: Display name of the primary account holder.

duplicate_flagged.description: True when duplicate callsigns were detected among existing accounts during the scan.

license_status.description: Current license status synced from the available licensing/callbook verification provider.

radio_service.description: Which radio service this callsign is licensed under (GMRS or HAM/amateur), from the verification provider. Empty on older records, which are treated as GMRS.

expiration_date.description: License expiration date from the verification provider, when available.

licensee_name.description: Licensee name from the FCC ULS record.

frn.description: FCC Registration Number from the ULS record.

license_country.description: Country associated with the verified amateur-radio or GMRS callsign.

verification_source.description: Provider used for the most recent callsign verification.

verification_method.description: Verification method used for the most recent callsign check.

last_check_date.description: When the license status was last checked against the available verification providers.

suspended.description: When true, the callsign verification is administratively suspended.

suspension_reason.description: Reason recorded by the admin when suspending verification.

description.description: Optional free-form note describing this callsign record.
